description: SWARM Code Health - Static health check of a public GitHub repo: TODO/FIXME debt, oversized files, possible committed secrets, README/.gitignore/LICENSE. Repos over 25 MB are refused before payment. Returns a Markdown report. $0.05. Pays in USDC on Base via x402 when SWARM_WALLET_KEY is set (quote checked against SWARM_MAX_USD first; charged only on success). On failure it says whether you were charged and if a retry is safe; it never retries on its own.
